description: This file contains unit tests for the SubjectCreated class, part of the Eclipse Ditto framework related to event policies. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling for the SubjectCreated event class.

classes.name: SubjectCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the SubjectCreated event, verifying its immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that SubjectCreated instances are immutable and that related classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods work correctly for SubjectCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that providing null for the policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that providing null for the PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that providing null for the label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Ensures that providing null for the subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of a SubjectCreated instance from valid JSON and verifies its fields.
